content:
Anya: Quick sync — thinking about saved queries in Console and how they interact with routing/quotas/telemetry. Proposal: attach an optional `fallback_policy` + `telemetry_hint` to saved queries so the UI can show a cost/quality preview when a route is quota-constrained. Thoughts?

Michael: +1 on surfacing cost. Important: keep routing internals private — UI should show recommendations/hints, not expose policy DSL.

Josh: For the API shape I suggest keeping it compact. Example saved query payload: 
```json
{
  "name": "Errors last 24h",
  "query": "status:500",
  "scope": "route:email-sender",
  "default_model": "gpt-redwood-1.3b",
  "fallback_policy": ["narrow_filters", "sample:0.1"]
}
```
This lets console preview without changing global route policy.

Priya: We should show telemetry stats (hit count, avg latency, token cost estimate) next to saved queries. Otherwise users save views that look fine locally but will be heavily sampled in production. Also show when metrics were last computed.

Anya: UX idea: when a saved view is applied and the route has quota/sampling, show a compact banner: "This view may be throttled — preview results with fallback applied" with a toggle to simulate fallback. Small CTA: "Preview" and "Apply anyway". :warning:

Michael: For rollouts / QA, add a per-saved-query "pin to model" toggle so a saved query can pin a model/version regardless of routing. Helps test regressions without modifying route-wide routing.

Josh: Backend preview endpoint I propose: `POST /api/saved_queries/preview` with body `{saved_query_id, route_id, simulate_fallback:true, dry_run:true}`. Response should include `preview_token_estimate`, `sampled_hit_estimate`, `applied_fallbacks` and a short human_reason for the chosen fallback.

Anya: Also surface diff between the route's live routing decision and the saved-query's pinned decision with a small inline comparison: "route chooses: redwood-vX (cost ~) vs saved query pins: gpt-redwood-1.3b".

Priya: One more: telemetry retention caveat — if stats are stale (e.g., >24h) show an indicator so users don't rely on stale cost estimates.

ConsoleBot: Reminder scheduled: design + API sync in 15 minutes.

Michael: Action items: backend preview endpoint PR (I'll take), add `fallback_policy` to saved query DB model (minimal fields only), and docs for microcopy. :thumbsup:

Josh: I'll mock the banner and preview modal. Will include microcopy for: "This view is using a fallback policy to stay within quota; results shown are simulated." Also add a small "simulate 3 variants" mode to show narrow vs sample tradeoffs.

Anya: Nice. Agreed ordering for fallback defaults: pin -> narrow_filters -> sample (with configurable thresholds). Add `dry_run` and `simulate_variants` flags to the preview API.

Priya: I'll prepare telemetry retention notes and a small table of which stats to show (hits, latency p50/p95, token estimate, last_updated).

Michael: Great. I'll open the backend PR and link the API contract in this thread.

Anya: Thanks everyone — sync in 15. /remind me 15
